newsSince: Richtech added a June 2026 24/7 interactive livestream for ADAM and continues to position ADAM/Dex around NVIDIA Isaac and Jetson Thor. The evidence supports embodied-AI visibility, but the business still has accounting/restatement, small scale and commercialization risks.

sources.label: Robot Report on ADAM livestream and NVIDIA stack
RR quote / market data as of 2026-07-09

verdicts.rankRationale: The ADAM livestream and Dex/NVIDIA stack keep Richtech directly on thesis, but the evidence is more marketing/demo than production economics. Hold with slight positive drift.
verdicts.bull: Direct small-cap humanoid platform with NVIDIA Isaac/Jetson Thor positioning and DEX showcased at Automate 2026.
verdicts.neutral: Visible at the marquee humanoid event, but revenue is tiny and the story is still demo-stage.
verdicts.bear: Persistent losses and a $200M shelf/ATM dilution overhang; conference buzz without contract wins; -41% YTD.
verdicts.primaryRisk: Dilution from shelf/ATM; demo-stage, sub-scale revenue
